But one gray morning, after a storm had churned the waves into froth, he spotted something bobbing near the rocks: a green glass bottle, corked tight. Tom set it on his windowsill, beside the logbook and the brass telescope, and for the first time in years, he looked at the lamp above him like it mattered to someone he'd never meet.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市还没睡醒，路灯把空荡的街道照得微微发黄。偶尔有一辆出租车驶过，车灯划开薄雾，又很快消失在转角。便利店的玻璃门里透出一点光，店员靠着柜台打哈欠，货架上的面包还没来得及补齐。远处传来清洁车缓慢碾过路面的声音，混着几声犬吠。高楼的窗户大多是黑的，只有极少几户还亮着灯，像是谁也没睡，又像是忘了关灯。风带着凉意穿过巷子，吹动一张被遗忘在长椅上的报纸。这座城市安静得近乎陌生，仿佛在等待某个人先醒来，才肯重新喧闹起来。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a function solves a big problem by asking a smaller version of itself to help, like a set of nested dolls where each doll opens to reveal a slightly smaller one\n- It needs a stopping point called a base case, like the tiniest doll that doesn't open anymore, otherwise it would keep going forever\n- Each smaller step adds its answer to the one before it, building up the final result once the smallest piece is solved"}
